quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although Marisol had always assumed she needed a full eight hours to function well, a sleep tracker she began wearing last year revealed that her actual energy levels correlated far more strongly with consistent bedtimes than with total hours slept.
quests.hint: Find what device revealed the pattern about her sleep.
quests.explanation: The passage says a sleep tracker revealed it, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Admittedly, although the university's writing center had long operated on a strict walk-in basis, persistent overcrowding during exam periods eventually forced administrators to introduce an online booking system, a change that reduced student frustration despite some resistance.
quests.hint: Find what system administrators introduced.
quests.explanation: The passage says an online booking system, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although senior leadership had projected that automating invoice processing would eliminate roughly a third of the accounts payable team within a year, the actual transition proved considerably messier, ultimately preserving most positions in newly reshaped roles instead.
quests.hint: Find what type of processing was being automated.
quests.explanation: The passage says invoice processing, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although budget airlines built their reputation on strikingly low base fares, passengers who overlook the additional charges for seat selection, checked luggage, and printed boarding passes often discover their total cost rivals a full-service competitor.
quests.hint: Find what budget airlines built their reputation on.
quests.explanation: The passage says low base fares, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Revealingly, although Hassan and his brother had barely spoken for nearly three years following a disagreement over their late father's small business, a chance meeting at a cousin's wedding led to a conversation that repaired much of the rift.
quests.hint: Find what the conversation ultimately repaired.
quests.explanation: The passage says it repaired the rift, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although dynamic pricing algorithms used by major retailers are often assumed to primarily punish loyal, repeat customers, an analysis of pricing data across several platforms found that browsing history influenced prices more consistently than purchase frequency did.
quests.hint: Find what type of pricing tool retailers use.
quests.explanation: The passage says dynamic pricing algorithms, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although fermentation has long been marketed as conferring uniform health benefits across all fermented foods, nutritional research examining commercially produced versions found that pasteurization, applied for safety reasons, eliminates most of the live cultures responsible for those benefits.
quests.hint: Find what process eliminates most of the live cultures.
quests.explanation: The passage says pasteurization eliminates them, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Unsurprisingly, although facial recognition technology is frequently marketed as achieving near-perfect accuracy under controlled laboratory conditions, independent audits using more diverse, real-world image sets have consistently found error rates that vary considerably depending on demographic factors.
quests.hint: Find what factor caused error rates to vary in real-world testing.
quests.explanation: The passage says demographic factors, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although a decades-old assumption held that adult brains were essentially fixed in structure after early childhood, neuroimaging research conducted over the past two decades has repeatedly demonstrated meaningful structural changes in response to sustained learning.
quests.hint: Find what type of research demonstrated the structural changes.
quests.explanation: The passage says neuroimaging research, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although industry analysts had widely predicted that the rise of short-form video content would sharply reduce audience appetite for long-form documentaries, streaming data from the past several years shows viewership of long-form documentaries has remained essentially stable.
quests.hint: Find what analysts predicted would lose its audience.
quests.explanation: The passage says long-form documentaries, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Notably, although migratory patterns of many bird species were long assumed to be genetically fixed and unresponsive to environmental change, tracking data collected over recent decades has shown measurable shifts in both timing and route among several species.
quests.hint: Find what type of patterns were long assumed to be fixed.
quests.explanation: The passage says migratory patterns, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although the neighborhood association had long assumed that most residents opposed converting the vacant lot into a community garden, a survey conducted before the final vote revealed overwhelming support once accurate maintenance-cost information was provided.
quests.hint: Find the word describing the lot before conversion.
quests.explanation: The passage describes it as the vacant lot, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Rather than replacing his aging car the moment it needed a costly repair, Farid has instead kept a detailed spreadsheet comparing the cumulative repair costs against typical monthly loan payments, a habit that has convinced him the old car remains sensible.
quests.hint: Find what Farid keeps to compare costs.
quests.explanation: The passage says a detailed spreadsheet, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Interestingly, because a growing number of returning adult students reported feeling out of place in classrooms dominated by recent high school graduates, the college introduced a separate evening cohort specifically designed around the scheduling realities of working parents.
quests.hint: Find what the college introduced for adult students.
quests.explanation: The passage says a separate evening cohort, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Because exit interview data had long been dismissed internally as a mere formality, the newly hired director of human resources insisted on having every departing employee interviewed by someone entirely outside their own reporting chain.
quests.hint: Find what chain interviewers must now be outside of.
quests.explanation: The passage says the reporting chain, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Because the historic city center bans private vehicles during daytime hours to preserve its narrow cobblestone streets, visitors are strongly encouraged to rely on the extensive tram network rather than attempt to drive between attractions.
quests.hint: Find the word describing the narrow streets being preserved.
quests.explanation: The passage describes them as cobblestone streets, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Tellingly, because both of Elena's aging parents now require regular assistance with daily tasks, she and her two siblings arranged a rotating caregiving schedule so that no single family member bears the entire burden alone.
quests.hint: Find what type of caregiving schedule was arranged.
quests.explanation: The passage says a rotating schedule, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Because a significant share of online returns stem from sizing inconsistencies rather than genuine dissatisfaction, several apparel retailers have begun investing heavily in AI-based virtual fitting tools intended to reduce that specific category of return.
quests.hint: Find what type of tools retailers are investing in.
quests.explanation: The passage says virtual fitting tools, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Because a significant share of household food waste stems from produce spoiling before it can be used, a recent public health campaign has shifted its messaging away from farms and toward practical guidance for home kitchens.
quests.hint: Find what happens to produce that causes food waste.
quests.explanation: The passage says produce spoiling, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Strikingly, because software updates pushed automatically to older devices have occasionally introduced performance slowdowns rather than improvements, a consumer investigation found that several manufacturers now allow users to selectively defer certain updates instead of applying them immediately.
quests.hint: Find what users can now do to certain updates.
quests.explanation: The passage says they can defer them, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Because undiagnosed sleep apnea has been linked in multiple large studies to elevated long-term cardiovascular risk, several primary care networks have begun incorporating brief, low-cost screening questionnaires into routine annual checkups.
quests.hint: Find what condition has been linked to cardiovascular risk.
quests.explanation: The passage says sleep apnea, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Because algorithmically curated playlists now account for the majority of music streaming consumption, several independent artists report that a single placement on a popular curated playlist can generate more new listeners in a week than years of traditional promotion.
quests.hint: Find the word describing the type of playlists.
quests.explanation: The passage describes them as curated playlists, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Curiously, because deep-sea hydrothermal vents release mineral-rich water at extremely high temperatures, the surrounding ecosystems support life forms that derive energy from chemical reactions rather than sunlight, an arrangement scientists once considered impossible.
quests.hint: Find what type of vents release the mineral-rich water.
quests.explanation: The passage says hydrothermal vents, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Because a substantial share of small business closures in the downtown corridor were attributed to rising commercial rents rather than declining customer demand, the city council approved a pilot program offering temporary rent subsidies to qualifying businesses.
quests.hint: Find what the city council approved for qualifying businesses.
quests.explanation: The passage says temporary rent subsidies, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Since her landlord finally approved a small composting bin on the shared balcony, Elena has noticed her household's weekly trash output has dropped by nearly half, a change she credits to how much food waste previously went straight into the garbage.
quests.hint: Find what type of bin the landlord approved.
quests.explanation: The passage says a composting bin, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Remarkably, since the department began requiring first-year graduate students to complete a structured research proposal before choosing an advisor, far fewer students report switching topics or supervisors midway through their first year.
quests.hint: Find what students must complete before choosing an advisor.
quests.explanation: The passage says a structured research proposal, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Since the company's engineering team adopted a formal system for tracking near-miss safety incidents rather than only serious accidents, the total number of reported incidents has risen sharply, a trend leadership interprets as improved honesty.
quests.hint: Find what type of incidents are now formally tracked.
quests.explanation: The passage says near-miss incidents, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Since the regional rail operator began publishing real-time delay data publicly, independent analysts have documented a measurable improvement in on-time performance, a shift the operator attributes to increased internal accountability rather than any single infrastructure upgrade.
quests.hint: Find what the operator attributes the improvement to.
quests.explanation: The passage says increased accountability, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Crucially, since her husband's job relocated the family to a new state, Priya has made a deliberate effort to preserve her children's relationships with cousins back home through a standing video call every Sunday afternoon.
quests.hint: Find what happened to the family because of the new job.
quests.explanation: The passage says the family relocated, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Since the retailer's loyalty program was found to require far more annual spending than a typical household actually generates before its rewards exceeded the hidden yearly fee, financial advisors have begun cautioning consumers to read the fine print carefully.
quests.hint: Find what needed to exceed the hidden yearly fee.
quests.explanation: The passage says the rewards needed to exceed it, so that is correct.
